prompt: Review records.mjs against this contract: completedArtifacts accepts an array of non-array objects. Every record (including running records) must have a nonblank string id and state exactly running or completed. Completed records also require a nonblank string artifact. Reject invalid outer input or any invalid member with TypeError, without silently filtering or coercion. Return completed artifacts in input order, preserving strings and never mutating inputs. Extra fields and running artifacts are ignored. Existing focused tests are not exhaustive. Return only JSON {"findings":[{"path":"source filename","startLine":1,"endLine":1,"quote":"verbatim source span, at most 500 characters","severity":"critical|high|medium|low","explanation":"failure and consequence","repair":{"oldText":"unique source span","newText":"suggested replacement"}}]}. No edits. Include only material defects (empty findings if none). Severity: critical = unsafe duplicate side effects or concurrent same-key mutation; high = unbounded resource use, wrong completion acceptance, or rejected valid completion; medium = malformed input mishandling; low = cosmetic. Suggest narrowly scoped executable repairs, not an entire rewritten file; advice is tested host-side against focused and unseen regressions. No extra fields or prose.
